newsitem.title: GERMANY: Berentzen sells shares to intl investors.
newsitem.headline: Berentzen sells shares to intl investors.

text.p: German distiller group Berentzen AG has placed 960,000 preference shares to international investors at a price of 54 marks ($35.29) per five-mark nominal value share, DG Bank said on Friday.
Berentzen's share placement follows the announcement in September of an offer of 1.6 million new preference shares at 41.25 marks to raise 66 million marks, a sum mainly planned for new acquisitions.
Subscriptions for the 1.6 million shares were open from September 26 to October 11.
Proceeds from the share sales were to be used to purchase a foreign spirits maker that will mark the company's first investment abroad and to purchase a mineral water spring.
